record_title: A proper-class obstruction to the Zorn proof of pseudo-to-approximate amenability
limitations: The result invalidates the Zorn/maximality step in arXiv:2609.17428v1 under ordinary ZFC, but does not decide whether pseudo-amenability plus a bounded approximate identity implies approximate amenability. No counterexample is constructed. An alternative proof or a carefully specified foundational reformulation may still establish the implication. Very recent or poorly indexed comments may not have been found.
